Unilateral CVA from flat EPE net of collateral, hazard-rate marginal PDs, LGD and discount factors, a variant of the UCVA sum.
Change from UCVA to BCVA with survival-weighted CVA and DVA legs; BCVA and DVA are planted as distractors.
UCVA as a running spread, -average EPE times credit spread with no LGD, with the yield-minus-risk-free spread input.
BCVA = CVA + DVA with each leg's own LGD, PD, exposure and the other party's survival; DVA positive.
